name: Mnemoverse Memory
description: Persistent memory for AI agents over MCP, backed by the hosted Mnemoverse memory engine. Write and read memories, report whether a recalled memory helped or misled so recall is re-ranked by that feedback, and share memory rooms between agents. One API key gives Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and ChatGPT the same memory. MIT server; the engine is a hosted service with a free tier.
author: Mnemoverse

MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY.description: Mnemoverse API key (mk_live_...). Free key from https://console.mnemoverse.com. The server starts and lists its tools without it; every tool call requires it.
